warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Jimboomba, Boonah, Clifton and Allora. 68 mm recorded at Millbrook in the 3 hours to 1:27 am. 65 mm recorded at Talgai in the 3 hours to 1:17 am. 83 mm recorded at Leyburn in the 3 hours to 1:00 am. 51 mm recorded at Torridon (Canal Creek) in the hour to 10:47 pm.

warnings.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning - Southeast Queensland for Toowoomba, Southern Downs, Scenic Rim, Lockyer Valley, Ipswich, Logan
warnings.desc: The Bureau of Meteorology warns that, at 3:45 am, severe thunderstorms likely to produce heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding were detected near Aratula. These thunderstorms are moving towards the east to northeast. They are forecast to affect Allora and Rosevale by 4:15 am and Harrisville and Peak Crossing by 4:45 am. 68 mm recorded at Millbrook in the 3 hours to 1:27 am. 65 mm recorded at Talgai in the 3 hours to 1:17 am. 51 mm recorded at Torridon (Canal Creek) in the hour to 10:47
